DEMO-STATION-01
DOC-0036 2026-10-12
MEETING NOTES — Staffing the Structures Review
Appointment
Date: 2026-10-12
Program: DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA
Attendees: PERSON-0001 for TEAM-0001; review roster clerk;
program report editor; collecting coordinator.
Purpose: Arrange reviewer coverage for the structures
discussion folder located by DEMO-AIR-0002, ISSUE-0150, and
TASK-0396.
Decisions The roster clerk will name a primary reviewer and a
substitute interval for appointments receiving work in the
awaiting_review category. The collecting coordinator will
confirm the expected paper-delivery time separately. Paper
collection must not consume the receiving reviewer's entire
appointment without the scheduling clerk knowing.
Use a review envelope for the appointment request. It contains
the question, record reference, expected reply role, and
requested discussion slot. The roster clerk returns a specific
alternative appointment if the requested interval cannot be
staffed.
The report editor will carry the question requiring a
decision, dependency role, and next discussion date into the
proposed weekly report layout. A schedule-change field will
preserve the earlier appointment when a new interval is
arranged. The layout discussion concerns field meaning,
without workload figures.
Action items
_— Owner: Review roster clerk. Due: 2026-10-13. Confirm the
primary reviewer and substitute interval with the collecting
